## Post

Your post body goes here. Standard Markdown. You can use footnotes via the usual `[^1]` syntax and internal links like `[other essay](./other-essay-slug)`. The slug is derived from this issue's title.

Leave the Metadata block above intact (the workflow reads importance/tags/status from those lines). To override the date, add `Date: 2026-06-18` to the Metadata block; otherwise the post is dated the day the issue is published.
